name: Navigation
purpose: derive navigation presentations from the canonical public site hierarchy without creating a second hierarchy authority

projections.global: project the children of the SiteTree root
projections.local: project the children of the current topic/site node
projections.breadcrumbs: project the ancestor chain of the current node
projections.activeState: derive current and active navigation state from SiteTree plus page/path context

rules: Navigation is not an independent hierarchy authority
navigation identity, labels, paths and parent-child structure come from SiteTree
Navigation must not duplicate a separately maintained tree beside /site.json
active state is derived from current page/path context and is not canonical SiteTree instance data
page actions and command buttons are Actions, not Navigation
Refresh and other page-data operations are not Navigation
API and service routing are separate machine-interface concerns and are not derived from the public SiteTree hierarchy
